NEET Exam Controversy Sparks Protests and Political Debate

Following allegations of a NEET exam paper leak, student protests have erupted across India. Families of three students who died by suicide have spoken out, linking their deaths to the exam controversy. Opposition leaders have challenged the government in Parliament, demanding accountability. Centrist outlets reported on various political stances, including calls to scrap NEET, blame on coaching centers, and the government's defense of its actions, highlighting the exam's impact on private coaching costs and its significance as a political test for the ruling party.
